title: Safety Audit Checklist
description: Free Safety Audit Checklist template you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers audit questions, findings, audit conclusion.
html:
REF: SAC-______ REVISION: 01 DATE: ____/____/________

DOCUMENT DETAILS
ORGANISATION / SITE: ______________AUDIT SCOPE: ______________
AUDIT STANDARD (ISO 45001 / OSHA / internal): ______________AUDITOR(S): ______________
AUDIT DATE: ______________AUDITEE REPRESENTATIVE: ______________

Audit Questions

ElementQuestionConforms (Y / N / NA)Evidence seen / comment
Leadership and policyIs a current signed safety policy in place and communicated?
Hazard identification and risk assessmentAre risk assessments current, task based and reviewed after change?
Legal complianceIs there a register of legal requirements and evidence of compliance?
ConsultationAre workers consulted and is a safety committee active?
Competence and trainingAre training needs met and records up to date?
Operational controlAre permits, isolation and contractor controls applied?
Emergency preparednessAre plans in place and drills held and recorded?
Incident managementAre incidents investigated, root causes found and actions closed?
MonitoringAre inspections, health surveillance and exposure monitoring carried out?
Management reviewIs performance reviewed by top management at planned intervals?
